name: Charlie Su
source:
He is the only son of the Zha family and sole heir of the NOVATEN Pharmaceutical Group, one of the world's four largest business conglomerates. Due to his distinguished family background, he is known as one of the most eligible bachelors and frequently appears in the news.

At the same time, he works as a burn unit surgeon at GuangQi First People's Hospital. He is an extremely talented doctor with first-rate medical skills. At work, he shows a different, serious side of himself.
